frame reference position

  • CURIE: gmeow:frameReferencePosition
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameReferencePosition
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/temporal

The reference position of a temporal frame, when one is needed. Optional: TAI needs none; civil time needs a timezone.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:TemporalFrame -> gmeow:ReferencePosition; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:frameReferencePosition from gmeow:TemporalFrame to gmeow:ReferencePosition when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
